shots.detail_en: CH slides his order slip to the counter as the opening bell dies away, knuckles perfectly steady.
shots.sub: 从今天起，我是砧板上的鱼。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Rapid cuts: the flip board bleeding green, CH's slip stack growing, retail heads shaking.
shots.sub: 扫地的那小子，被联华永盛套住了！
shots.speaker: 散户甲

shots.detail_en: CH folds a loss slip in half and files it into the notebook like collecting a debt.
shots.sub: 挨一记，记一笔。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH's notebook page: beside his drawing of a well, the outermost ring is crossed out.
shots.sub: 明面上我在挨打——暗地里，我在剥它的皮。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: The demon stock dives off its ledge and snaps back again and again while CH's small orders get swept away each time.
shots.sub: 他割肉了！扫地僧也栽了！
shots.speaker: 散户乙

shots.detail_en: After the close RED hands over a hand-copied funding-flow page, knuckles white with grip.
shots.sub: 这层套的钱，年纪比我大——是压箱底的老钱。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH's fingertip pins one corner of the page — only a dotted frame shows, never the figures.
shots.sub: 这层的味道……跟天台那场雨一样旧。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: CH places another small order the next day, quietly taking a planned small loss.
shots.sub: 我输的每一分钱，都是买它账本的一页。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Triple loop of cross-cut: the board flickers green once, then one ring of the well peels away in the notebook, three rounds over.
shots.sub: 挨三打，剥三层。井壁，越来越薄。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: MANCANG spins in place outside the hall, clutching his pager, stamping his feet in a panic.
shots.sub: 老大的船在漏水啊！我全仓的心跟着一起漏啊！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: RED folds a fresh ledger page into a small square and passes it under the counter, whispering.
shots.sub: 第三层下面还有第四层——井，比你画的深。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI's machine room: dozens of screens glowing, the PREY ENTERED tag above a loss curve sliding downward.
shots.sub: 亏损曲线正常。猎物在流血。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: A warning pops up — the loss speed is unnaturally even; XIONGWEI's brow tightens for the first time.
shots.sub: 人在亏钱会乱。他的乱……是排过队的。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Data-stream imagery: CH's losses line up as one neat staircase across the screens.
shots.sub: 他每一拳，都打在我画好的格子上。
shots.speaker: 熊伟（画外）

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI overlays his ten-year model: CH's order paths stab in like probes at each joint of the funding shells.
shots.sub: 他在……验我的骨头。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI's finger hangs above the keyboard — for the first time in ten years, it does not come down.
shots.sub: 他不是在交易——他在解我。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI rises for the first time in ten years, pacing the machine room as racks of light flow across his lenses like a river.
shots.sub: 猎人第一次发现——自己才是被瞄准的那个。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI stops at the main screen: under the red tag, the loss curve hangs like an upside-down fishing line.
shots.sub: 爸，你的鱼——在检查鱼钩。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: In the hall the same moment, CH shuts the notebook and looks up toward the mezzanine machine room he has never entered.
shots.sub: 三层剥完了。明天，该他来看我了。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: In rooftop rain RED holds an umbrella over the last ledger page, one corner of the paper water-blurred.
shots.sub: 最后一层的名字被洇掉了。可纸很老——老得像那年六月。
shots.speaker: 红利

shots.detail_en: CH lays his father's notebook and the ledger page side by side, the missing-page gap held up to the lamplight.
shots.sub: 爸，井底的影子，露头了。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: Black screen with the next-episode teaser card in white text.
shots.sub: 熊伟解开了陆长虹——井壁只剩最后一层。
shots.speaker: 字幕
shots.card: 熊伟解开了陆长虹——井壁只剩最后一层。
